cell_line.evidence: THP‐1 cells, a human monocytic cell line derived from an acute monocytic leukaemia patient, were purchased from American Type Culture Collection (Cat# TIB‐202) and maintained in Roswell Park Memorial Institute (RPMI) 1640 medium (Fisher Scientific, Cat# MT10040CV) in 10% fetal bovine serum (VWR International, Cat# 97068‐085) with 1% penicillin and streptomycin (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Cat# 15140163) at 37 °C in 5% CO2.
